keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 10 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 40 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

top_papers.why: Shows encoder-free native VLA policies consistently outperform encoder-based ones, challenging standard robot learning architectures with controlled comparisons.
top_papers.key_result: NEO-VLA, a structurally encoder-free vision-language-action framework, with only its action expert trained reaches 90.9% average LIBERO success, compared with 79.5% for Qwen3-VL and 84.5% for Gemma-3, and full fine-tuning brings the average to 95.3%; layer-wise probing shows action-critical signals often peak well before the final visual representation.
evidence: With only its action expert trained, NEO-VLA reaches 90.9% average success, compared with 79.5% for Qwen3-VL and 84.5% for Gemma-3. Its frozen-backbone score is also comparable to both fully fine-tuned encoder-based models. On LIBERO-Long, it reaches 85.4%, exceeding their full-FT results.

More strikingly, layer-wise probing shows that the action-critical signals often peak well before the final visual representation. Across diverse manipulation settings and distribution shifts, NEO-VLA consequently achieves stronger and more robust control.
Full fine-tuning provides improvements, bringing the average to 95.3%.
With a frozen backbone, skip-28 scores 90.9% compared with 86.7% for end-28. It also scores higher with full fine-tuning (95.3% versus 92.5%).

news.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
news.summary: OpenAI announced a partnership with Hacktron, in which OpenAI engineers and Hacktron security researchers jointly select high-priority areas to test, focusing on how OpenAI systems interact with third-party services, and Hacktron gets expanded access to frontier models through Daybreak Red. The post notes OpenAI recently announced Cathedral researchers joining its next security sprint and raised bug bounty rewards, and that Hacktron builds AI agents for code review, penetration testing and red teaming.

news.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
news.summary: Cult.fit standardized engineering on Codex and extended it beyond engineering, with non-engineering teams building more than 20 internal applications in recent months and rebuilding an internal capability with Codex for $100,000+ in annual software savings. The company reports a 50%+ reduction in customer support costs and built a social feed end to end in two months, a project estimated to have previously taken more than a year.

news.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
news.summary: OpenAI reports collaborations with Australian universities including UNSW Sydney, University of Sydney, La Trobe University and Adelaide University, with UNSW bringing ChatGPT Edu to more than 80,000 students and staff. In a survey of more than 1,000 Australian university students, 81% said they use AI several times a week, 33% multiple times a day, 28% had built an AI agent or assistant, and 79% wanted more opportunities to use advanced AI tools on real-world projects.

news.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
news.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with native 15-second video generation, up from 10 seconds in Omni 1.1, duration specified in one-second increments from 3 to 15 seconds, improved reference adherence and multi-turn conversational editing. The price dropped 30% from Gemini Omni 1.1 to $0.07 per second for 720p video, and the model is generally available on the Gemini API and Gemini for business.

news.title: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
news.summary: Google DeepMind describes Cheminformatics Skills for Google Antigravity, a suite grounded in RDKit with connectors to ChEMBL and PubChem in which the language model orchestrates workflows while deterministic chemistry tools run molecular calculations. In a walkthrough on lung cancer treatments, an agent searched thousands of compounds, performed matched molecular pair analysis and proposed rigidified macrocycles with synthetic routes in about an hour; the text uses crizotinib (five major rotatable bonds) and lorlatinib (cyclized to zero effective rotatable bonds) as the rigidification example.

news.title: Detecting signs of hypertension using wearable sensors
news.summary: Google Research presented AI-PPG-ACC-HTN, a multimodal AI system that uses smartwatch photoplethysmography and accelerometry to passively detect signs of hypertension without cuff calibration, validated against 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring. The waveform encoder was trained with self-supervised contrastive learning on 492,347 hours of sensor data from 2,109 consenting participants.

news.title: Agile Deliberation: How AI helps humans define the gray areas
news.summary: Google Research introduced Agile Deliberation, a framework that treats building subjective image classifiers as an iterative conversation with an LLM-driven prompt refinement loop, split into concept scoping and concept iteration stages, with code open-sourced on GitHub. It was evaluated in 18 live 1.5-hour sessions with human participants rather than simulated testing.

news.title: The latest AI news we announced in October 2026
news.summary: Google recapped October AI updates including the global rollout of Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier reasoning model, and the announcement two weeks later of Gemini 4 Carbon, which is in pre-release testing with the U.S. government and trusted cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program. It also introduced Genie 4 for real-time interactive world simulation with native audio and expanded SynthID Detector globally in English after watermarking more than 180 billion images and videos and 240,000 years of audio.

news.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
news.summary: Microsoft Research introduced PDD Kit, a toolkit that turns a developer’s intent into a formal specification in Verus, proves agent-written code meets that specification for every input, and falls back to tests where a proof cannot reach. In a full-stack web app test, PDD Kit was used to formally verify the login logic of Pet Store, a Rust storefront, with the developer reviewing the intent and not reading the generated code line by line.

news.title: Learn the rules: The hacker mindset
news.summary: A Microsoft Research podcast episode features research manager Mike Walker discussing how hacker culture led him to cyber defense work, including developing the first all-machine hacking tournament and leading DARPA's Cyber Grand Challenge, which the text says marked its 10th anniversary in 2026. He argues effective security depends on understanding trust and context, since every security request asks for user trust.

news.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
news.summary: NVIDIA reported that a year after open-sourcing its Aerial wireless software, adoption of NVIDIA AI Aerial and NVIDIA Sionna software has grown 10x, its open source 5G/6G tools have surpassed 1 million downloads, and more than 8,000 research and academic institutions use the platforms. It described research projects: a King's College London robot arm setup using Sionna and Jetson AGX Orin that cut task completion time by up to 52.6%, a SoftBank neural receiver in Aerial CUDA-Accelerated RAN with higher uplink throughput at all 15 tested settings and a maximum gain of roughly 60%, and ETH Zurich tuning that reduced block error rates by more than one-third.

news.title: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA announced performance results for its Vera CPU, reporting that in a 100-megawatt data center comparison a single Vera CPU outperforms both the fastest x86 CPU and the most energy-efficient x86 CPU, with 1.6x more agents per watt versus the fastest x86 CPU and 2x faster agent speed versus the most energy-efficient x86 CPU. Partners include Perplexity, which ran agentic coding tasks 1.5x faster with Vera, and DeepInfra, which reported up to 2.2x speed on agentic orchestration.

news.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA described developers directing frontier AI models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude through natural-language instructions, combined with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries, to build simulation applications. Examples include recreating an OP-1 portable synthesizer, testing robotic disassembly of a car suspension in Isaac Sim, and creating an editable building model from site scans.

news.title: The Wizard of Open Weights: Chris Alexiuk Makes AI Easy With Open Models
news.summary: NVIDIA profiles Chris Alexiuk, a senior product research engineer in deep learning who teaches developers to build with open large language models and calls himself “No. 1 Nemotron Fan” for NVIDIA’s Nemotron family of open source, multimodal models. The article describes his use of YouTube and X to teach building, fine-tuning, evaluating and shipping LLM applications and agents.

news.title: Speed Up Image Generation with FLUX 3 Image Klein on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
news.summary: NVIDIA published a tutorial on running FLUX 3 Image Klein (Base and distilled) in TensorRT LLM VisualGen on Blackwell GPUs, reporting that NVFP4 gave up to 1.62x faster text-to-image and 1.58x faster image-to-image generation than BF16 on a single B200, and that combined optimizations reached up to 3.46x T2I and 4.45x I2I speedups at 2048x2048 versus uncompiled BF16. It also lists per-technique results, including Cache-DiT reaching 1.94x at 2048x2048 with LPIPS 0.033, and multi-GPU CFG plus Ulysses parallelism on eight B200s reducing median T2I latency from 14.90 to 3.00 seconds for Base and from 2.73 to 1.08 seconds for distilled.

news.title: Accelerating Reinforcement Learning Weight Refit with the Reshard Collective
news.summary: NVIDIA described the Reshard collective, which reformulates reinforcement learning weight refit as a DTensor-to-DTensor transfer that moves only the theoretical minimum data between differing training and inference layouts instead of using gather-and-broadcast, with an open source reference implementation, NCCL M2N Reshard, in the NVIDIA/nccl-extensions GitHub repo. In NeMo RL benchmarks on DGX H100 and DGX GB200 systems it reports 2.7x to 5.7x speedups over gather-and-broadcast refit across models including Qwen 3 235B and DeepSeek v3 671B, and notes payloads estimated at 10 TB per refit for today's largest open weight models.

news.title: Configure, Certify, and Operate Kubernetes GPU Clusters with NVIDIA DSX OS
news.summary: NVIDIA introduced NVIDIA DSX OS, an open source software layer in the DSX AI Factory Platform for configuring, certifying and operating Kubernetes GPU clusters, including NVIDIA AI Cluster Runtime, Cluster Readiness Engine and NVSentinel. All three projects are licensed under Apache 2.0.

news.title: Five Ways NVIDIA Co-Design Maximizes the Value of Every Byte in the AI Factory
news.summary: NVIDIA described five co-design techniques for maximizing the value of memory in AI factories, including NVFP4, which reduces model footprint by approximately 3.5x versus FP16 and 1.8x versus FP8. The company reports that Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers up to 30x the throughput per megawatt of GB300 NVL72 from the same 288 GB per GPU.

news.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
news.summary: Hugging Face introduced FoundationWorlds, a framework pairing a controlled simulated world with automatic task and demonstration generation plus behavioral metrics, with ToyBlocks as the first release: an open simulation framework built around a robot arm and blocks on a tabletop that auto-generates demonstrations without teleoperation and uses domain randomization over block size, table height and other properties. ToyBlocks builds on earlier work including MolmoAct 2, MolmoBot and MolmoSpaces, uses RL and motion planning to generate skills, and includes blocks with pictures and letters for searching, sorting and arranging tasks.

news.title: Egyptian and Nigerian English join the Open ASR Leaderboard
news.summary: Hugging Face's Open ASR Leaderboard added two private accent splits through a collaboration with Liva AI: Liva AI Conversational EG (Egyptian) and Liva AI Conversational NG (Nigerian), both conversational and spontaneous speech. The leaderboard now also reports US vs. non-US breakdowns and Inner Circle (US, UK, Australia, Canada) vs. Outer and Expanding Circles (India, Nigeria, Egypt), following earlier private splits from Appen, DataOceanAI and Voice Arena.

news.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
news.summary: NVIDIA added four new open-weight checkpoints to its Cosmos 3 world model family: Cosmos3-Nano-Transfer-Auto, Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto, Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Transfer and Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Bimanual. All four are post-trained examples of Cosmos 3 Nano with 16B trainable parameters and use the OpenMDW1.1 license, permitting commercial and non-commercial use under its terms.

news.title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
news.summary: Hugging Face detailed Phonon, an on-device text-to-speech model released two weeks earlier that runs without a server or network, comes in roughly 65 MB and 75 MB sizes, covers English, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese with more than 100 built-in voices, and uses flow matching from the Pocket TTS lineage. Phonon 31m (English) is Apache 2.0 and Phonon 40m covers all five languages under a non-commercial license; the post reports more than 200,000 downloads in the first two weeks and evaluation on the Open TTS Leaderboard across 23 languages.

news.title: Faster Retrieval for Better, More Efficient RAG
news.summary: Apple researchers presented "Amortizing Maximum Inner Product Search with Learned Support Functions" at ICML 2026, training small neural networks offline for a fixed key database to route queries toward their best match faster, trading an upfront amortization cost for faster and more accurate retrieval at inference. The work frames MIPS as the support function of the key set, a convex function approximable by neural networks designed for convex functions, and argues that query-agnostic methods miss the stable query distributions typical of production RAG and search use.

news.title: SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference added GPU partitioning via NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), dividing a physical GPU into independent hardware-isolated partitions with dedicated compute and memory so each partition can host a different model. MIG splits one GPU into as many as seven instances depending on the GPU; partitioning works on endpoints that use inference components, and single-model endpoints, serverless endpoints and heterogeneous instance pools cannot be partitioned.

news.title: Taxonomy of agentic primitives in Amazon Quick
news.summary: AWS described the taxonomy of agentic primitives it converged on while building Amazon Quick, decomposing agentic work into four questions: When?, What?, Who? and How? It defines triggers (human-initiated, agent-delegated, scheduled, event-driven), an agent as a persistent learning actor made of instructions, capabilities and learned context, and capabilities as tools, skills and workflows, with the LLM treated as a swappable model parameter and conversation history as per-session state.

news.title: Serverless MCP server for AI agent data lake access on Amazon ECS Fargate
news.summary: AWS built a serverless Model Context Protocol (MCP) server on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate as a centralized, agent-agnostic gateway between AI agents and its enterprise data lake for Amazon's North America Sort Center planning teams. Exposing a new dataset requires only a JSON metadata file that the server discovers on the next pipeline sync, replacing per-agent integration code that previously took a multi-day effort per table; the architecture has four independently scalable layers with a metadata catalog for schema knowledge, Cognito authentication, and centralized permission enforcement at the server layer.

news.title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 2
news.summary: In part 2 of a series, AWS extends its Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore setup from one agent and two MCP servers to an enterprise topology: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway becomes the single front door and redeems Okta's grant for each target, and one default-deny Cedar policy set evaluated at the Gateway replaces per-server groups checks. The agent's role no longer holds token-exchange or secret permissions, a second agent on Amazon EKS joins under its own Okta identity, and AgentCore Observability with CloudWatch collects OpenTelemetry spans and Okta's System Log for auditing.

Reinforcement learning remains the largest theme at 193 papers, while retrieval-augmented generation dropped to 52. Among top reads, Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation (126 upvotes) reports 4-step streaming video at 147.6 DiT FPS on eight H200 GPUs; From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies reaches 90.9% average LIBERO success; Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit advances streaming video RL; and Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models shows a 7%p GenEval gain. news.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
news.summary: NVIDIA报告称，在开源其Aerial无线软件一年后，NVIDIA AI Aerial和NVIDIA Sionna软件的采用量增长了10x，其开源5G/6G工具下载量已超过1 million次，超过8,000家研究和学术机构使用这些平台。它描述了研究项目：伦敦国王学院的机器人手臂装置使用Sionna和Jetson AGX Orin，将任务完成时间最多缩短了52.6%；软银在Aerial CUDA-Accelerated RAN中的神经接收器在所有15个测试设置下都实现了更高的上行吞吐量，最大增益约为60%；苏黎世联邦理工学院的调优将误块率降低了三分之一以上。

news.title: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA 公布其 Vera CPU 的性能结果，报告称在 100-megawatt 数据中心对比中，单颗 Vera CPU 同时超越最快的 x86 CPU 和最节能的 x86 CPU，与最快的 x86 CPU 相比每瓦可多承载 1.6x 的智能体，与最节能的 x86 CPU 相比智能体速度快 2x。合作伙伴包括 Perplexity（使用 Vera 运行智能体编码任务速度提升 1.5x）和 DeepInfra（报告在智能体编排上速度提升最高 2.2x）。

news.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA 描述了开发者通过自然语言指令调用 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude 等前沿 AI 模型，并结合 NVIDIA Omniverse 库来构建仿真应用。示例包括复刻 OP-1 便携合成器、在 Isaac Sim 中测试汽车悬架的机器人拆卸，以及根据现场扫描创建可编辑的建筑模型。

news.title: The Wizard of Open Weights: Chris Alexiuk Makes AI Easy With Open Models
news.summary: NVIDIA 介绍了 Chris Alexiuk，他是一位深度学习领域的高级产品研究工程师，教授开发者使用开放大语言模型进行构建，并称自己是 NVIDIA Nemotron 开源多模态模型系列的“No. 1 Nemotron Fan”。文章描述了他利用 YouTube 和 X 教授 LLM 应用和智能体的构建、微调、评估与上线。

news.title: Speed Up Image Generation with FLUX 3 Image Klein on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
news.summary: NVIDIA 发布了一篇教程，介绍在 Blackwell GPU 上的 TensorRT LLM VisualGen 中运行 FLUX 3 Image Klein（Base 和 distilled），报告称与 BF16 相比，在单块 B200 上 NVFP4 使文本到图像生成速度提升最高 1.62x，图像到图像生成速度提升最高 1.58x；在 2048x2048 分辨率下，与未编译的 BF16 相比，组合优化使 T2I 和 I2I 加速分别达到最高 3.46x 和 4.45x。文中还列出了各技术的结果，包括 Cache-DiT 在 2048x2048 下达到 1.94x，LPIPS 为 0.033；在八块 B200 上使用多 GPU CFG 加 Ulysses 并行将 Base 的 T2I 中位延迟从 14.90 秒降至 3.00 秒，distilled 从 2.73 秒降至 1.08 秒。

news.title: Accelerating Reinforcement Learning Weight Refit with the Reshard Collective
news.summary: NVIDIA 介绍了 Reshard 集合通信操作，它将强化学习的权重重拟合重新表述为 DTensor 到 DTensor 的传输，在不同训练和推理布局之间仅移动理论最小数据量，而非使用 gather-and-broadcast；参考实现 NCCL M2N Reshard 已在 NVIDIA/nccl-extensions GitHub 仓库中开源。在 DGX H100 和 DGX GB200 系统上的 NeMo RL 基准测试中，与 gather-and-broadcast 重拟合相比，它在包括 Qwen 3 235B 和 DeepSeek v3 671B 在内的模型上实现了 2.7x 至 5.7x 的加速，并指出对于当前最大的开放权重模型，每次重拟合的负载估计为 10 TB。

news.title: Configure, Certify, and Operate Kubernetes GPU Clusters with NVIDIA DSX OS
news.summary: NVIDIA 推出 NVIDIA DSX OS，这是 DSX AI Factory Platform 中的一个开源软件层，用于配置、认证和运行 Kubernetes GPU 集群，包括 NVIDIA AI Cluster Runtime、Cluster Readiness Engine 和 NVSentinel。这三个项目均采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。

news.title: Five Ways NVIDIA Co-Design Maximizes the Value of Every Byte in the AI Factory
news.summary: NVIDIA 介绍了五种在 AI 工厂中最大化内存价值的协同设计技术，其中包括 NVFP4，与 FP16 相比可减少约 3.5x 的模型占用，与 FP8 相比约减少 1.8x。该公司报告称，在相同每 GPU 288 GB 的条件下，Vera Rubin NVL72 的每 megawatt 吞吐量最高可达 GB300 NVL72 的 30 倍。

news.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
news.summary: Hugging Face 推出 FoundationWorlds，这是一个将受控仿真世界与自动任务和演示生成以及行为指标相结合的框架，首个发布为 ToyBlocks：一个围绕机器人臂和桌面上的积木构建的开放仿真框架，可在无需遥操作的情况下自动生成演示，并在积木大小、桌面高度及其他属性上使用域随机化。ToyBlocks 建立在 MolmoAct 2、MolmoBot 和 MolmoSpaces 等先前工作之上，使用 RL 和运动规划生成技能，并包含带图片和字母的积木，用于搜索、分类和排列任务。

news.title: Egyptian and Nigerian English join the Open ASR Leaderboard
news.summary: Hugging Face 的 Open ASR Leaderboard 通过与 Liva AI 合作新增了两个私有口音划分：Liva AI Conversational EG（埃及）和 Liva AI Conversational NG（尼日利亚），两者均为对话式自发语音。该排行榜现在还报告美国与非美国的细分，以及 Inner Circle（美国、英国、澳大利亚、加拿大）与 Outer and Expanding Circles（印度、尼日利亚、埃及）的对比，此前已有来自 Appen、DataOceanAI 和 Voice Arena 的私有划分。

news.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
news.summary: NVIDIA 为其 Cosmos 3 世界模型系列新增了四个开放权重检查点：Cosmos3-Nano-Transfer-Auto、Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto、Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Transfer 和 Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Bimanual。这四个均是 Cosmos 3 Nano 的后训练示例，具有 16B 可训练参数，并使用 OpenMDW1.1 许可证，根据其条款允许商业和非商业使用。

news.title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
news.summary: Hugging Face详细介绍了Phonon，这是一款两周前发布的端侧文本转语音模型，无需服务器或网络即可运行，尺寸约为65 MB和75 MB，支持英语、法语、德语、西班牙语和葡萄牙语，内置超过100种声音，并使用来自Pocket TTS谱系的流匹配技术。Phonon 31m（英语）采用Apache 2.0许可证，Phonon 40m在非商业许可证下覆盖全部五种语言；文章报告前两周下载量超过200,000次，并在Open TTS Leaderboard上对23种语言进行了评估。

news.title: Faster Retrieval for Better, More Efficient RAG
news.summary: Apple 研究人员在 ICML 2026 上发表了《Amortizing Maximum Inner Product Search with Learned Support Functions》，通过离线为固定键数据库训练小型神经网络，将查询更快地路由到其最佳匹配，以一次性的摊销成本换取推理时更快更准确的检索。该工作将 MIPS 视为键集的支持函数，这是一种凸函数，可由为凸函数设计的神经网络近似，并认为与查询无关的方法忽略了生产级 RAG 和搜索应用中典型的稳定查询分布。

news.title: SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference通过NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG)添加了GPU分区功能，将物理GPU划分为独立的硬件隔离分区，具有专用计算和内存，使每个分区可以托管不同的模型。MIG根据GPU类型将一个GPU最多划分为七个实例；分区适用于使用推理组件的端点，而单模型端点、无服务器端点和异构实例池不能进行分区。

news.title: Taxonomy of agentic primitives in Amazon Quick
news.summary: AWS描述了在构建Amazon Quick时收敛的智能体原语分类法，将智能体工作分解为四个问题：何时？什么？谁？如何？它定义了触发器（人工发起、智能体委托、定时、事件驱动），将智能体定义为由指令、能力和学习上下文组成的持久学习执行体，并将能力定义为工具、技能和工作流，其中LLM被视为可替换的模型参数，对话历史被视为每会话状态。

news.title: Serverless MCP server for AI agent data lake access on Amazon ECS Fargate
news.summary: AWS在Amazon ECS上使用AWS Fargate构建了一个无服务器Model Context Protocol (MCP)服务器，作为AI智能体与其企业数据湖之间的集中式、智能体无关网关，服务于Amazon北美分拣中心规划团队。暴露新数据集仅需要一个JSON元数据文件，服务器在下一次管道同步时发现该文件，取代了以前每个表需要多天工作的每智能体集成代码；该架构有四个可独立扩展的层，包括用于模式知识的元数据目录、Cognito身份验证以及服务器层的集中权限执行。

news.title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 2
news.summary: 在系列文章的第2部分中，AWS将其Okta Cross App Access和Amazon Bedrock AgentCore设置从一个智能体和两个MCP服务器扩展为企业拓扑：Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway成为单一前门，并为每个目标兑换Okta的授权，一个默认拒绝的Cedar策略集在Gateway上评估，取代了每服务器组检查。智能体角色不再持有令牌交换或密钥权限，第二个智能体在Amazon EKS上以其自己的Okta身份加入，AgentCore Observability与CloudWatch收集OpenTelemetry span和Okta的系统日志用于审计。
